description: Design system foundation + data layer + UI primitives. Establishes the color palette, typography, CSS custom properties in globals.css using Tailwind v4 @theme inline syntax, then creates lib/data.js with all portfolio content, and builds three reusable UI components (SectionWrapper, AnimatedText, GradientButton). These are the shared building blocks every section component depends on.
steps: Replace app/globals.css entirely. Keep @import 'tailwindcss' at top. Replace the existing :root / @theme inline block with the full design system: define --color-bg-primary (#0a0b0f), --color-bg-secondary (#0f1117), --color-bg-card (#13151f), --color-accent (#6c63ff), --color-accent-light (#8b85ff), --color-accent-secondary (#00d4aa), --color-text-primary (#f0f0f5), --color-text-secondary (#9999bb), --color-text-muted (#666688), --color-border (#1e2035). Inside @theme inline { } map them so Tailwind generates utilities: --color-bg-primary, --color-bg-secondary, --color-bg-card, --color-accent, --color-accent-light, --color-accent-secondary, --color-text-primary, --color-text-secondary, --color-text-muted, --color-border. Also set --font-sans to 'Inter' and --font-display to 'Sora'. Add base styles: html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }, body gets bg-bg-primary text-text-primary. Add custom scrollbar styles using ::-webkit-scrollbar with accent color. Add a .gradient-text utility class using background-clip: text with a linear-gradient from accent to accent-secondary. Add a .section-padding utility: padding 5rem 0. Add keyframe animations for blob pulse and gradient shift. Remove all dark: media query references — the site is permanently dark.

Replace app/layout.js. Keep the Geist font imports but add Inter and Sora from 'next/font/google'. Set Inter as --font-sans CSS variable and Sora as --font-display. Update metadata: title 'Chukwuebuka — Frontend Developer', description 'Electrical Engineering graduate and Frontend/Full-Stack Developer building modern web applications'. Add OpenGraph metadata. Apply all four font variables to the html element className. Body keeps min-h-full flex flex-col. File stays a Server Component (no 'use client').

Create lib/data.js. Export a PERSONAL object: { name: 'Chukwuebuka', title: 'Frontend & Full-Stack Developer', subtitle: 'Electrical Engineering Graduate • UNN 2:1', tagline: 'Building modern, responsive, functional web applications', bio: (2-3 sentence professional bio about EE grad from UNN with interest in web development), email: 'your@email.com', github: 'https://github.com/yourusername', linkedin: 'https://linkedin.com/in/yourusername', twitter: 'https://twitter.com/yourusername', location: 'Nigeria' }. Export a SKILLS array with categories: { category: 'Frontend', skills: [{name:'React', icon:'SiReact', color:'#61DAFB'}, {name:'Next.js', icon:'SiNextdotjs', color:'#fff'}, {name:'Tailwind CSS', icon:'SiTailwindcss', color:'#38BDF8'}, {name:'JavaScript', icon:'SiJavascript', color:'#F7DF1E'}, {name:'HTML5', icon:'SiHtml5', color:'#E34F26'}, {name:'CSS3', icon:'SiCss3', color:'#1572B6'}] }, { category: 'Backend', skills: [{name:'Node.js', icon:'SiNodedotjs', color:'#339933'}, {name:'Supabase', icon:'SiSupabase', color:'#3ECF8E'}, {name:'PostgreSQL', icon:'SiPostgresql', color:'#336791'}, {name:'REST APIs', icon:'SiPostman', color:'#FF6C37'}] }, { category: 'Tools', skills: [{name:'Git', icon:'SiGit', color:'#F05032'}, {name:'GitHub', icon:'SiGithub', color:'#fff'}, {name:'VS Code', icon:'SiVisualstudiocode', color:'#007ACC'}, {name:'Figma', icon:'SiFigma', color:'#F24E1E'}, {name:'Vercel', icon:'SiVercel', color:'#fff'}] }. Export a PROJECTS array: [{ id:1, title:'Huncho Electrical', description:'A professional electrical materials sales, installation and maintenance platform.', longDescription: '3-4 sentence detailed description', tech:['Next.js','Tailwind CSS','Supabase','PostgreSQL'], github:'https://github.com/yourusername/huncho-electrical', live:'#', featured:true, gradient:'from-purple-600 to-blue-600' }, { id:2, title:'FX Checker', description:'A full-featured currency exchange application with real-time rates.', longDescription:'3-4 sentence detailed description', tech:['React','Frankfurter API','JavaScript','CSS'], github:'https://github.com/yourusername/fx-checker', live:'#', featured:true, gradient:'from-teal-500 to-emerald-600' }]. Export a SERVICES array: [{ title:'Frontend Development', description:'Building pixel-perfect, performant UIs with React and Next.js', icon:'Code2' }, { title:'Full-Stack Development', description:'End-to-end web applications from database to UI', icon:'Layers' }, { title:'API Integration', description:'Connecting third-party services and building REST APIs', icon:'Zap' }, { title:'Performance Optimization', description:'Auditing and optimizing web app speed and Core Web Vitals', icon:'TrendingUp' }, { title:'Responsive Design', description:'Mobile-first layouts that work beautifully on every screen', icon:'Smartphone' }, { title:'Technical Consulting', description:'Architectural guidance and code reviews for web projects', icon:'MessageSquare' }]. Export an EXPERIENCE array: [{ type:'education', title:'Bachelor of Engineering — Electrical Engineering', org:'University of Nigeria, Nsukka', date:'2018–2023', description:'Second Class Upper (2:1). Specialized in electronics and control systems.', icon:'GraduationCap' }, { type:'experience', title:'Frontend Developer (Freelance)', org:'Self-employed', date:'2022–Present', description:'Building client web applications using React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. Delivered production projects including e-commerce and fintech tools.', icon:'Briefcase' }].

Create components/ui/SectionWrapper.jsx. Mark 'use client' at the top. Accept props: id (string), className (string), children. Use Framer Motion: import { motion, useInView } from 'framer-motion'. Use a ref + useInView({ once: true, margin: '-80px' }). Wrap children in a motion.section with: id={id}, className combining 'section-padding' with any passed className, initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 40 }}, animate based on inView: { opacity: inView ? 1 : 0, y: inView ? 0 : 40 }, transition={{ duration: 0.7, ease: [0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1] }}.

Create components/ui/AnimatedText.jsx. Mark 'use client'. Props: text (string), className (string), el (element tag, default 'h2'), delay (number, default 0). Import { motion, useInView } from 'framer-motion'. Split text into words and animate each word with staggered entrance: each word wrapped in motion.span with initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}, animate when inView, stagger delay of 0.05 * index + delay. Return the element (el) containing the word spans.

Create components/ui/GradientButton.jsx. Mark 'use client'. Props: children, href (optional), onClick, variant ('primary'|'outline', default 'primary'), className, size ('sm'|'md'|'lg', default 'md'). Import { motion } from 'framer-motion'. Primary variant: rounded-full px based on size, gradient bg from accent to accent-secondary via linear-gradient, text white, shadow with glow effect using box-shadow with accent color at 0.3 opacity. Outline variant: rounded-full border border-accent text-accent hover:bg-accent hover:text-white. Wrap in motion.div with whileHover={{ scale: 1.04 }} whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}. If href provided render as anchor tag, otherwise as button.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 after this FEAT
globals.css defines all 10 CSS custom properties and they generate Tailwind utility classes (bg-bg-primary, text-accent, border-border etc.)
lib/data.js exports PERSONAL, SKILLS, PROJECTS, SERVICES, EXPERIENCE without syntax errors
SectionWrapper, AnimatedText, and GradientButton each have 'use client' at top and import from framer-motion correctly
app/layout.js loads Inter and Sora fonts and passes them as CSS variables
verification: npm run build — must complete with exit 0 and no errors
